chunks: And in the narration of Ḥammād ibn ʿUthmān, from Ḥarīz, he said: Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said:
"A woman in ihram lets the garment hang over her face down to the chin."

key_terms.الْمُحْرِمَةُ: a woman who is in the state of ihram
key_terms.تَسْدُلُ: she lets hang down or drape

ai.seo_question: How should a woman in ihram cover her face according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the dress of a woman in the state of ihram. It states that she may let a cloth hang over her face down to the chin, clarifying a specific practical matter in the fiqh of hajj.
